item.title: Trump's Summit with Xi and Putin, Inside Nvidia, Northwestern Students Stop Attack: AM Update 11/20 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
President Trump meets with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin for a historic trilateral summit focused on nuclear weapons, global security, and international cooperation. Nvidia offers employees early pay raises and additional stock compensation as thousands push for Jensen Huang's reinstatement following his resignation. Three Northwestern University freshmen rescue a female classmate from a violent attack after a stranger reportedly follows students into a campus dormitory and attempts to strangle her. A millionaire entrepreneur funds indefinite protests against Saks Fifth Avenue after the luxury retailer fires his 62-year-old mother just five days after she is assaulted by a customer.
